plugins.name: Lacuna
plugins.description: A complete visual shell for Omarchy with a custom bar, attached utility sidebar, system controls, expressive widgets, and optional desktop ambience.
plugins.author: OldJobobo
plugins.installNote: After cloning, run cd "$HOME/lacuna" && ./scripts/lacuna to start the guided installer.

plugins.name: Omni
plugins.description: A standalone Omarchy shell command palette for apps, files, themes, GitHub search, tldr, and local Ollama prompts.
plugins.author: bjarneo
plugins.installCommand:
omarchy plugin source add https://github.com/bjarneo/omarchy-shell-plugins --as bjarneo
omarchy plugin add omni --from bjarneo --enable
plugins.installNote: This adds bjarneo as a plugin source, then installs and enables Omni.

plugins.name: QuickApps HUD

plugins.author: bjarneo
